bullets.text: In Ambattur, a young man named Hariprasad died after falling into an open rainwater drainage pit, and the office should monitor drainage safety.
Near Periyapalayam in Thiruvallur district, an armed youth tried to burn a college student with petrol, and the office should track the police action.
A district principal court in Thiruvallur sentenced a youth to double life imprisonment for raping a 21-year-old tribal woman in Pazhaverkadu.
The Greatail case seeking a ban on constructions around the Pallikaranai wetland has been adjourned for judgment by the Green Tribunal.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss released a video highlighting climate change risks and creating awareness through Green Tháyagam regarding Pallikaranai.
Document writers and typists in Gummidipoondi went on strike protesting the registration department's privatization attempt.
The Greater Chennai Corporation proposed a Rs 200-crore infrastructure upgrade plan for Guindy and Ambattur industrial estates in two phases.
Cooperation Minister inaugurated the crushing season at the Tiruttani Cooperative Sugar Mill, targeting two lakh tonnes this year.
The IndiaAI Mission and Sweden discussed strategic cooperation in artificial intelligence and digitalisation under SITAC.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay virtually inaugurated Raptee.HV's flagship electric motorcycle experience centre in Chennai from the Secretariat.
Nearly 1,800 Tamil books supplied to Coimbatore's Periyar Arivulagam library were flagged over suspected AI-generated content and factual errors.
Chief Minister Vijay started discussions with TVK MLAs at a Mamallapuram hotel amid opposition criticism over worsening law and order.
Senior BJP leader L. Murugan criticized the Tamil Nadu government, stating there is no difference between the TVK administration and previous rule.
Chief Minister S. Joseph Vijay test-drove a miniature bike while launching Raptee.HV's electric motorcycle experience centre backed by state investment.
